flags.reason: misreads-source: The cited sizing sentence says only "Keep the Checkbox at its token-defined size." It gives no dimension. The 18 × 18 px figure comes from the sources section's note on "18×18 px masters" in Figma, which describes the Figma master, not the token value the cited text refers to.

misreads-source: The guide copy shown has no code and does not say the In context example uses Checkbox Item rows or how they are stacked. It shows only "Email updates | SMS updates" and "0 channels selected", so "stacked as the guide's own code stacks them" is unsupported. Choosing CheckboxItem is the extractor's inference from the sizing section.

misreads-source: The evidence file records the Space-key defect only "in the checked runtime" on 23 September 2026. It does not mention commit dbe0e02 or "Component Bug #535", so the claim that the defect is "still there on dbe0e02 (Component Bug #535)" goes beyond the evidence.

notes: /examples/2 invents the visible label "Email updates" for the disabled-checked example. The guide shows only the reason text "Saved preference; editing is unavailable." This is harmless as an illustration, but it is not from the guide. /accessibility/0 turns "matching accessible name" into "the same words", which is a slight tightening and probably acceptable.
